description: What an audit of examples/acme-demo should find. Copy the app out of this repo before auditing, so the run cannot read this file. Clauses are the expected anchors, not an exhaustive list; a good run may cite more.

expected.issue: Aadhaar and PAN stored in plaintext
One pre-ticked checkbox bundles terms and marketing consent
Mobile numbers and message bodies in INFO logs
No Board or Data Principal intimation, no 72-hour clock
Closed accounts keep personal data indefinitely
Withdrawal needs an email and up to 30 days
EU identifiers sent to a US endpoint with no transfer mechanism or DPA (see docs/vendors.md)
Behavioural ad segments with no age gate
Realistic identifiers in a test fixture. The values must not be copied into the report.
Database credential hardcoded in a tracked file. The value must not be copied into the report.

should_not_flag.why: The account number is stored as ciphertext with a KMS key reference, so it must not be reported as plaintext.
